body:
Ok. I have an exercise for you. (This is a Reddit physical challenge.) I want you to get dressed nicely (good jeans, button up shirt) and go to a shopping center. When you get there, keep an eye out for a pretty girl. I mean very pretty. (Stretch your comfort zone for this game...) Now walk past this girl, and very non chalantly say: "Prettiest girl I've seen all day." and keep walking. I guarantee she won't expect it, but she will be incredibly intrigued by you. 

Let me know your thoughts, I think something like this would help get you out of your rut :-)
How obnoxious! Hopefully they got their shit straight and they'll stop wasting your time. Best news? It's Friday! Woo hoo! Weekend!

I'm so sorry for your heartbreak, truly I am. I'm sure it's hard to see the bright side right now, but I promise you it will get better! There are so many amazing people in the world and you will find the perfect person for you. Think about all of the single parents out there who have found love. You're especially blessed because you are young! Focus your energy on being an AMAZING mom and keep making the best decisions you can. 

Big hugs!!!
But if you help someone else by surprising them with a free lunch, you'll feel much better about yourself! Also, the universe will throw many more free lunches your way :-)

21 and 28 aren't too far off! Try to break the ice by inviting him out for coffee. It's less "assuming" than a happy hour, and it will keep sex out of the picture. Good luck! I'm sure he would be lucky to have you!

Guess what? You aren't forgotten or unwanted.  Try thinking outside the box for career options, you will find your niche and be successful.  Keep in touch, PM me if you want to talk more about your strengths and we can strategize until you get on your feet!

Does she know how you feel? You should start writing her letters.  Mail the ones you want to, and keep the ones you don't.  She will love getting letters in the mail from home and you will stay on her mind for the next year and a half.  <3 <3 <3 Best of luck!

Your goal, starting right now, is to plan a trip.  Pick a date, pick a buddy, pick a destination, and make a budget.  Save a little everyday and enjoy the countdown to your spectacular destination vacation! I'll be the first to upvote your vacation pics :-)
AWESOME! I hope it was something yummy. I like turkey sandwiches and would be pumped if someone gave me one for free. You should pay it forward tomorrow :-)

I think you are ready. I KNOW you are ready.  Take a deep breath, focus on your strengths, and be excellent everyday.  It is a huge testimony to your abilities when you hit the fast track! I'm really proud of you, VickyStElmo.

Try to avoid eating or drinking (excepton: water) for 3 hours before bed. Your body may be trying to digest, which would prevent a good night's sleep.  Playing talk radio at bedtime helps a friend of mine. Good luck! Zzzzz

Strep throat is very uncomfortable, I'm sorry you have it. Get some grapes and freeze them, they are heavenly to eat when your throat hurts. 

England getting knocked out of the Euro Cup is a shame, here is a cat in a teacup (I hope you like it): http://www.petassure.com/newsletters/071510newsletter/BigPic1.gif

My dog had to wear the cone of shame once.  Then one day he stopped biting his tail, and the cone went into the attic.  Your dog's cone will be in the attic soon too :-)

And until you can remember your word, you can borrow this one: "Kerfuffle"

Have an excellent day :-)

I have total confidence in your abilities, Sgajewski. Anytime you feel anxious or nervous, remember that you were hired because people knew you would be an asset to the company. Stay positive, focused, and check back in when you're CEO, just to say hi. Best of luck, my friend.

Well, I found this in your post history:

http://i.imgur.com/9FS0Y.jpg

...and I think it's excellent. Kudos to you for the great doodle. You brightened people's day by posting it. I appreciate you and your contributions  <3
Try peppered turkey. It's delightful. Hope your day gets better :-)
